American Horror Story 13 Ep 1–6 Recap: Did the Devil Win? 😈 Constance's Deal, Cordelia's Death and My Fiona Theory

short // Oct 6, 2026

Watch on YouTube

Cordelia got killed on Devil's Night, and that's not even the most messed-up thing that happened in American Horror Story 13 this week. 😈

Constance just broke a 15-year-old rule to get her daughter back.

⚠️ Spoilers for American Horror Story 13 through episode 6.

The rule from Season 1

Murder House set the rule back in 2011. Die on cursed property, and you're trapped there as a ghost forever. Die anywhere else, and your soul is free.

The best example was the last time Constance and Addie shared the screen. On Halloween night, Addie was hit by a car, and Constance dragged her body toward the Murder House like a Black Friday doorbuster. She missed the lawn by inches. Addie died on the street, crossed over, found peace and never became a ghost.

So how is Addie back?

In AHS 13, Addie is partying at Club Hell with Tate, Kai Anderson and the Black Dahlia herself.

Girl, how'd you get an Uber from Heaven?!

Now we know. Constance made a deal with the Devil to be a mama again. Technically, she made it with Mr. Nas, Satan's son. He offered her the one thing she always wanted, another chance at being a mother, and she sealed it with a kiss. Her soul belongs to him now, and that's how Tate and Addie are back.

So Addie's Uber driver? Satan. Well, his son.

Devil's Night comes to the Coven

And Hell's not done. In episode 6, "The Return of Devil's Night," James March, the Hotel ghost who threw a murder dinner party every Devil's Night, brings his dead serial killers to Miss Robichaux's Academy: Jeffrey Dahmer, the Zodiac and Richard Ramirez, the Night Stalker.

That's how Cordelia goes down. While she's protecting one of her students, March puts his scythe in the back of her head.

Dead serial killers against the Coven? That's an all-out Avengers war.

This isn't Cordelia's first death

Cordelia already sacrificed herself once, in Apocalypse. Her death gave Mallory the full power of the Supreme, and Mallory reset the whole timeline. So dying hasn't exactly been the end for her.

And right before March showed up, the witches were using a spirit board to summon her mama, Fiona. The last time we saw Fiona, in the Coven finale, she was stuck in her own personal hell: a cabin with the Axeman, forever.

My theory: Fiona's redemption arc

Here's my theory: Fiona comes back from her own personal hell, brings her baby back, and the Goode women face off one last time. That's Fiona's redemption arc.

A deal with the Devil is a classic horror loophole, and it fits a season built around Satan's son. But if anybody can come back, do the old rules still mean anything?

Sources: TVLine: Cordelia's death explained, TheWrap: AHS 13 episodes 4 to 6, Comic Basics: episodes 4, 5 and 6 recap, Mac Observer: why Tate, Kai and the Black Dahlia are together, Wikipedia: American Horror Story season 13

Quick answers

How does Cordelia die in American Horror Story 13? In episode 6, "The Return of Devil's Night," James March and his dead serial killers attack Miss Robichaux's Academy, and March kills Cordelia with a scythe to the back of the head.

How is Addie back in AHS 13? Constance made a deal with Mr. Nas, Satan's son, to be a mother again. In exchange for her soul, Tate and Addie are back.

Why wasn't Addie a ghost in Murder House? She was hit by a car and died off the Murder House property, so her soul crossed over instead of being trapped in the house.

When did American Horror Story 13 premiere? September 24, 2026, on FX and Hulu, with 13 half-hour episodes running up to Halloween.

Is Jessica Lange back as Constance? Yes. Jessica Lange returns as Constance Langdon, and Sarah Paulson is back as Cordelia Goode.

Your turn

Deal with the Devil: clever loophole, or did they officially jump the shark? 👇
